Deepak: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Deepak: did kernel-batcher refactor (split out microbatch slot allocator), ran 1k-sample perf sweep against q4f16+kv-cache. Baseline p50 ~11ms/token, p99 spike +40ms under short bursts.
Deepak: blocker: noticed KV priming stalls when >80 concurrent reqs hit same shard; tail latency jumps. attaching short log snippet below.
Deepak: ```
[2026-03-16T02:10:12Z] kv_client.go:214 priming miss shard=shard-7 req=0.043s
[2026-03-16T02:10:12Z] kernel_batcher.go:478 slot_wait 0.012s
[2026-03-16T02:10:12Z] rpc.go:102 timeout retry 1/3 0.05s
```
Jia: can you paste the bench command + config used? :eyes:
Deepak: yep — command + flags: ```./bench --model=redwood-q4f16 --batcher=continuous --samples=1000 --seq=512 --prefetch=0.0 --kv-warm=true```
Mike: fyi I saw a cluster-level net blip on host-gpu-12 around 02:10 (packet drops ~0.3%). could be correlated with the KV RPC retries. @opsbot can you pull net logs for host-gpu-12 02:05-02:15? :mag:
opsbot: logs collected and uploaded: https://internal-gist/reports/6432109876/netlogs-host-gpu-12.txt (contains tcp retransmits + interface stats). :robot_face:
Sara: if priming misses on a hot shard, we could add a short randomized prefetch to spread the load. i can prototype a cheap bloom-prefetch that sends 1 small prefix RPC at jittered offsets.
Jia: another quick tuning to try: probabilistic prefetch (e.g. --prefetch-prob=0.15) + small exponential backoff on RPCs (start=5ms, cap=50ms). hedges the thundering herd without huge extra cost.
Deepak: good call. plan for today: 1) reproduce with a controlled load harness that pins requests to shard-7; 2) try --prefetch-prob=0.15 and jittered priming RPCs; 3) run a focused 5k-sample bench to validate p99 improvements. will open PR for the jitter change.
Deepak: ping for review: PR #4512 (batcher: prefetch jitter + seedable rand). want a quick CR before I merge and canary.
Mike: looking now — left a tiny comment about rand.Seed placement and a missing unit test for deterministic behavior. :white_check_mark: overall looks good.
Jia: i'll try the prefetch-prob flag in local harness and report perf delta.
Sara: i'll prototype the bloom-prefetch sketch this afternoon, can wire it behind a flag.
Deepak: thanks all — i'll post quick canary results once i run the 5k sweep. will also attach the harness config when done. :thumbsup:
opsbot: canary deploy finished for batcher/jitter v0.3 -> canary group: batch-hosts-4. No OOMs; small p50 improvement observed on canary (2.5%).
Deepak: awesome, noted. if canary looks stable after another run i'll schedule a gradual rollout. thanks!
